ExternalRiskEstimate.justification: FICO-family risk score: higher = less risky (protective).

MSinceOldestTradeOpen.justification: Longer credit history reduces default risk.

MSinceMostRecentTradeOpen.justification: Recency of newest account is directionally ambiguous.

NumSatisfactoryTrades.justification: More satisfactory accounts = stronger repayment record.

NumTrades60Ever2DerogPubRec.justification: Any 60d+ delinquency count is directly risk-increasing.

PercentTradesNeverDelq.justification: Share of clean trades is protective.

MSinceMostRecentDelq.justification: Longer since last delinquency is protective.

MaxDelq2PublicRecLast12M.justification: Worse recent delinquency severity increases risk.

MaxDelqEver.justification: Worst-ever delinquency severity is a lasting risk marker.

PercentInstallTrades.justification: Installment mix effect is directionally ambiguous.

MSinceMostRecentInqexcl7days.justification: Longer since last inquiry is protective.

NumRevolvingTradesWBalance.justification: More revolving accounts carrying balance = higher risk.

NumInstallTradesWBalance.justification: More installment accounts carrying balance = higher risk.

NumBank2NatlTradesWHighUtilization.justification: Prime-bank accounts near-max utilized = higher risk.

PercentTradesWBalance.justification: Higher share of accounts carrying balance = higher risk.

InquiryToTradeRatio.justification: Inquiry intensity relative to trades increases risk (engineered).
